This plot is small and close to our home, so I can easily manage it with my family. I will spread manure on it because we have livestock and the fruit trees grow better with it, but I will not use chemical fertilizer since what little I can get from the cooperative I must save for my cereal fields. These are local trees intercropped with food crops, so I do not need improved seeds or pesticides, and I will rely on the rains rather than irrigate. My mother, sister, and I can do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves on this small plot, so I will not hire outside labor.
